ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), Submitted__c != true, $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Product Defective or Unsatisfactory"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Goods_Or_Services_Returned__c,'Y')), OR( ISBLANK(Description), OR( ISPICKVAL(Goods_Or_Services_Returned__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Goods_Or_Services_Returned__c, 'NA') ), ISBLANK(Merchant_Description__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Description of Issue, Goods Or Services Returned, What Happened with Merchant?
